regions.merged_text: Just a line while I have time to gratulate you and wish you every blessing. Mary Casey just phoned - is coming out this p.m. to have a little visit, before going back to-night to camp. .. Her mother Emma scalded herself recently rather badly and James Jr. had an operation oo his les. ... . otherwise things seem about as usual on the Coast. I wrote Fr. Edward a few days ago - have not bad word from him in a long time. I know he has very little time for himself - what quite pleases him, I think. God bless you now and all my old friends in "City of fine Schools, Villas & Terraces"
